fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is chain-link fenced along S Shortridge Rd, but the single vehicle entrance (cow statue + Crossroad Farms monument sign) is an open driveway gap with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in 2022/2024 Street View. Trucks and cars share this open entrance, then route to the W/SW/S docks. Classified no-gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. The brick structure beside the drive is the monument sign, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance apron and deep internal yard; ample paved width to add a dedicated truck bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long rows of unhitched reefer trailers wrap the N, NW and SW edges along the I-465 ramp; large dedicated drop-yard, easily 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~28 across the west building face, an interior dock court, and a detached cooler/dock building; partial occlusion by backed-in trailers and roof structures.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs N-S just inside the E boundary along Shortridge Rd, but no active spur/dock serving the building is visible (cars and a road occupy the area between rail and building); treated as not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Indianapolis metro: dense residential subdivision immediately E across Shortridge, other industrial/DC buildings adjacent N and S, bounded by I-465 to the W.
